message.reasoning: GPT is offering me Short Line for $225, which would give me a second railroad and the rent bonus that comes with it. But accepting means handing cash to my weakest opponent when he's nearly broke at $203—exactly what he needs to stay in the game longer. I'd rather let him collapse and pick up Short Line cheaply at auction instead.
